paper_title: Evidence for light-by-light scattering and searches for axion-like particles in ultraperipheral PbPb collisions at sqrt(s_NN) = 5.02 TeV
notes: CMS light-by-light (gamma gamma -> a -> gamma gamma) search in ultraperipheral PbPb, m_a = 5-90 GeV. Headline ALP-photon limit is the 95% CL observed curve in Fig. 7 left plot (operator a F Ftilde / 4Lambda, ALP coupling to photons only), which the paper states gives the best limits over m_a = 5-50 GeV. The paper defines g_agamma == 1/Lambda with L operator a F Ftilde/(4 Lambda), identical to the canonical g_agamma of L=-(g/4) a F Ftilde; reported directly as 1/Lambda in GeV^-1, no conversion needed. Curve extracted as vector polyline from Figure_007-a.pdf (green solid = observed); x-axis linear (calibrated x=188.9->10 GeV, x=527.2->100 GeV, minor ticks 2 GeV), y-axis log (y=116.7->1e-3, y=307.1->1e-4). Vertices are the drawn polyline points at m_a ~= 5,6,9,11,14,16,22,30,90,100 GeV; the 30-90 GeV segment is a single straight drawn line in the figure. Right plot (extra hypercharge/EW couplings) not reported. Excluded region is above the curve. Collider search, no DM density dependence.
